$comment: Production npm packages whose licence is not on build/licenses/allowed-licenses.json. Each entry names the exact package, its licence and why it is accepted. scripts/check-licenses.mjs fails on anything else, and on an entry that no longer matches.

exceptions.reason: TypeScript's runtime helpers; every Angular package depends on it and it is bundled into the app. 0BSD is a public-domain-equivalent permissive licence without attribution duty.

CLDR plural rules used by @messageformat/core, which the Transloco ICU plugin needs for plurals (master plan 11.7). Bundled. The Unicode data licence is permissive (OSI-approved) and only asks to keep the notice, which the build's 3rdpartylicenses.txt does.
Pulled in by @jsverse/transloco-utils -> cosmiconfig -> js-yaml, which load Transloco's tooling configuration in Node. Never imported by the browser bundle. Python-2.0 is permissive.
